method: Visual review of the saved crop image against its inline verified reference. Exclude from paired OCR-versus-clean NER metrics only when the crop visibly includes neighboring text or the reference covers text outside the crop. This is a development-only scope control; it does not alter the annotations or page images. One corrected region was recropped and OCR-checked; its updated box now covers only the reference sentence. Two Washington Daily News article crops were retightened and OCR-checked; their text now covers the reference story without the previously included neighboring material. The Cordele Stafford/Ingram region was confirmed against its reference, which contains both adjacent social notes, and was restored to the paired set. Cordele Jane Campbell was aligned with a page-coordinate polygon mask on the final line; OCR words after “this place.” were removed by their positions, retaining the full sentence. The New Britain fingerprint headline is represented by two disjoint, page-coordinate OCR regions (headline and subheadline); vertical-rule artifacts were removed from the subheadline crop. Douglas masthead/issue-line/lead are represented as three separate page-coordinate OCR parts to avoid top-page neighboring stories; the parts retain page-pixel boxes.
